title: Preventive Maintenance, Maharlika Highway (Manila South Road)
description: PREVENTIVE MAINTENANCE - PRIMARY ROADS MAHARLIKA HIGHWAY (MANILA SOUTH ROAD) - K0045 + 720 - K0045 + 810
colour_meaning: Look first: an official warning record, or two signs of risk together.
contractor: Way Maker General Contractor Opc (winning bidder)

reasons.title: A bidder's name matches the government blacklist
reasons.detail: WAY MAKER GENERAL CONTRACTOR OPC ([REVOKED] 52351): matches the GPPB blacklist (name match - verify)
reasons.evidence: Official record (GPPB blacklist, via OpenSanctions). A name match is not proof that it is the same firm.
checks: Open the blacklist entry and compare the licence (PCAB) number, address and company type with the bidder's.
Check that the debarment period covers the bid date; debarments expire.
Check whether the matched firm won or lost; a losing bidder matters less once the contract is awarded.

reasons.title: A bidder is listed with a revoked licence marker
reasons.detail: WAY MAKER GENERAL CONTRACTOR OPC ([REVOKED] 52351): DPWH lists this name with a [REVOKED] licence marker
more: WAY MAKER GENERAL CONTRACTOR OPC ([REVOKED] 52351): matches the GPPB blacklist (name match - verify)
WAY MAKER GENERAL CONTRACTOR OPC ([REVOKED] 52351) has 1 project(s) rated unsatisfactory by Bisto citizen site inspectors
reasons.evidence: DPWH's own record shows “[REVOKED]” next to the bidder's licence number.
checks: Look the firm up on the PCAB “verify a contractor” page (pcab.construction.gov.ph/verify).
Check whether the licence was revoked before the bid date, and whether that bidder won.

reasons.title: Price per km above 95% of similar works
reasons.detail: Official budget ₱125.2M per km; the 95th percentile of similar works (Preventive maintenance / asphalt, 459 past contracts) is ₱96.1M per km. Length read from the title: 90 m.
reasons.evidence: In past DPWH road contracts this was linked to about 2.2 times the odds of termination.
checks: Check the stated length against the plans or Bill of Quantities; a wrong length distorts price per km.
Look for items that raise cost but are not road surface: drainage, slope protection, bridges, lighting.
Compare unit prices for the main items (concrete, asphalt) with similar contracts nearby.

reasons.title: Citizen inspectors rated the winner's other work unsatisfactory
reasons.detail: WAY MAKER GENERAL CONTRACTOR OPC ([REVOKED] 52351) has 1 project(s) rated unsatisfactory by Bisto citizen site inspectors
reasons.evidence: From Bisto Proyekto volunteer site inspections.
checks: Open the inspections of the winner's other projects on bisto.ph.
